CONF_SWAPFILE.description: Path where the swapfile is located.

CONF_SWAPSIZE.description: Absolute swapfile size in megabytes. If empty/null, computed dynamically.

CONF_SWAPFACTOR.description: Multiplier for RAM size when computing swap size dynamically.

CONF_MAXSWAP.description: Maximum allowed swap size in megabytes (computed or absolute).
